answer: The design leans on time-locked work history, revoked by a single upheld challenge, no identity may audit its own recruit. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Every claim climbs the nectar of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the opal re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
